programs.name: Workshop: No Sew Halloween Decor with Caregiver
programs.description: Celebrate the spooky season with a cozy and creative Halloween workshop for caregivers and children! Together, participants will design and create an adorable no-sew ghost, bat or pumpkin using colourful felt, stuffing, and fun Halloween decorations. Whether your creation is silly, spooky, or sweet, this hands-on workshop is perfect for little crafters and their grown-ups to enjoy side-by-side. Families will leave with a soft handmade keepsake and plenty of festive memories to treasure all season long!

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description: Spend a day experimenting,  playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed  for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary  abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before  bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique  final artwork. No experience necessary—just  come ready to experiment and make something your own!

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description: Spend a day experimenting,  playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed  for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary  abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before  bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique  final artwork. No experience necessary—just  come ready to experiment and make something your own!

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description: Spend a day experimenting,  playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed  for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary  abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before  bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique  final artwork. No experience necessary—just  come ready to experiment and make something your own!
